scripts.switch:build: tsc -p scripts/wq-switch/tsconfig.json && bun build scripts/wq-switch/index.ts scripts/wq-switch/setup.ts --outdir=scripts/wq-switch/dist --target=node --format=cjs
scripts.build: bun run browser:build && bun run tooling:build && bun run core:build
scripts.packages:build: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/browser/react build && bun run --cwd packages/browser/angular build
scripts.pr:verify: bun run check:prop-order && bun run packages:build && bunx vitest run --project tooling && bunx vitest run --project unit
scripts.browser:build: bun run theme:generate && bun build src/playground/playground.ts --outfile=src/playground/playground.bundled.js --loader .html:text --loader .css:text && stencil build --config packages/browser/components/stencil.config.ts
scripts.core:build: bun run switch:build && bun build scripts/webquark-serve.ts --outfile=scripts/webquark-serve.js --target=node --format=cjs && bun run scripts/build-core.ts
